purpose: Define the evidence and fixture contract required before any Math selector v3 materialization or Stage-C rerun.

source_failure.interpretation: Current Math selector removes or underweights useful training signal.

redesign_requirements: separate malformed extraction handling from budget selection
preserve long reasoning and worked-solution coverage
cap short-answer dominance instead of banning short examples
penalize template redundancy without suppressing useful recurrence
report tail topic retention before Stage-C training

selector_v3_policy.short_answer_low_context_cap: cap only low-context short-answer items; do not cap long worked QA derivations

forbidden_actions: using heldout math NLL, GSM8K, MATH, or Utility outcomes as Stage-B features
removing failed Math evidence from the paper ledger
claiming all-domain improvement before a new frozen Stage-C pass
next_allowed_action: Materialize Math selector v3 from these frozen pre-outcome requirements, then freeze a new Stage-C protocol before training.
